name: Wind Chime of Romance
description: Wind chimes symbolize good luck and represent prayers and blessings. The wind blows and the bell rings, conveying the voice from the heart. Pinku's special gift metal puzzle "Double Thoughts Wind Chime" is based on the "Double Thoughts" from "Thousands of Years·Singing the Wind", "The heart is like a double mesh, with thousands of knots in it", and incorporates the meaning of a butterfly breaking out of a cocoon, forming its own wings, and encircling happiness, and embodies good blessings and inner wishes.
